?

Find the gradient vector field of the function f(x,y)=2x−1−4y+1.

a
24x−1i−12y+1j
b
12x−1i−24y+1j
c
22x−1i+14y+1j
d
14x−1i−22y+1j
e
12x−1i+44y+1j
